trends.snippet: Pole is whoever does not lift for the marshal. Dummy quali chatter — not a timing feed.

trends.snippet: Gold trophy talk in the garage. Dummy points math. Not official F1.

trends.headline: Double stack mixup at the box
trends.snippet: Second car waited like it was a drive-through. Same compound. Same mistake.

trends.headline: Undercut window is three cars wide
trends.snippet: Nobody is taking it. Overcut paid last dummy stint. Tire offset math on the couch.

trends.headline: Dummy 2026 grid talk in the paddock
trends.snippet: New regs, new faces, no real entry list here. Phase 2 is an API. Tonight is vibes.

places.title: Monaco
places.snippet: Quali is the race. Barriers, yacht energy, and a formation lap that feels like a parade.

places.title: Spa-Francorchamps
places.snippet: Eau Rouge in the blood. Weather that changes twice a sector. Safety cars love it here.

places.title: Silverstone
places.snippet: Copse, Maggotts, Becketts. Crowd roar. Dummy British GP weekend chatter.

places.title: Monza
places.snippet: Temple of speed. DRS detect on the main straight. Slipstream is a religion.

places.title: Suzuka
places.snippet: Figure-eight. 130R. Quali laps that look illegal. Dummy Japanese GP energy.

places.title: Interlagos
places.snippet: Interlagos weather, championship points, and a last-lap DRS that bottles into the hairpin.

places.title: Marina Bay
places.snippet: Night race. Walls. Safety car magnet. Paddock/night-race canvas energy.

places.title: Circuit of the Americas
places.snippet: T1 climb, T12 overtake, dummy COTA weekend. Formation lap up the hill.
